name: Translation reminder on publish
description: Logs a reminder when a translatable parent transitions to status=published, prompting the editor to verify fr and es translation rows.

name: Publish site
description: D6 manual Publish (2026-10-25): one build per editing session. Run from Site Config (build_queue) → Flows → Publish site. POSTs this environment's Vercel deploy hook ($env.VERCEL_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL, allow-listed in FLOWS_ENV_ALLOW_LIST) with buildCache=false. Edits never rebuild the site by themselves.

options.confirmationDescription: Publish site: rebuild this environment's website from the current published CMS content (one build, about 3 minutes).
